output: Machine learning is a branch of AI in which models learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.
An algorithm is a finite sequence of well-defined steps used to solve a problem or perform a computation.
Python is a high-level programming language widely used for software development, automation, data science and artificial intelligence.
Deep learning is a machine learning approach that uses neural networks with multiple layers to learn representations from data.
An LLM is a large language model trained on large amounts of text to understand and generate natural language.
Fine-tuning adapts a pretrained model to a particular task or dataset by training it further on task-specific examples.
LoRA is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that learns a low-rank weight update while keeping the pretrained model weights frozen.
Singular Value Decomposition factorizes a matrix into left singular vectors, singular values and right singular vectors.

instruction: Why use GPUs for deep learning?
output: GPUs can perform many matrix operations in parallel, making neural-network training much faster than typical CPU execution.
Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too closely and performs poorly on unseen data.
A neural network is a model made of interconnected computational units that learn parameters from data.
Natural Language Processing is the field of AI concerned with processing, understanding and generating human language.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning updates only a small number of trainable parameters while keeping most pretrained parameters frozen.
A transformer is a neural architecture based primarily on attention mechanisms and is widely used for language modeling.
Freezing pretrained weights reduces memory and computation requirements and helps retain knowledge learned during pretraining.
A singular value measures the strength of a corresponding singular direction in a matrix.
A low-rank matrix can be represented using fewer independent dimensions than its full matrix dimensions.
Attention lets a model assign different importance to elements of an input when producing a representation.
Inference is the process of using a trained model to generate predictions or outputs for new inputs.
A dataset is a collection of examples used to train, validate or evaluate a machine-learning model.
